handoff_instructions: M2-T12 done: added new packages/agents workspace package (package.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.mjs mirroring packages/domain). Next: M2-T13 'Transfer tool' should implement the domain/core service behind request_transfer's contract (authorize, same-org check on communicationId, create an ops case or task, event+audit), matching the pattern in packages/core/src/services/tasks.ts createCallbackTask.
